name: spo-bulk-file-rename-script
title: SharePoint Bulk File Rename Script
shortDescription: Bulk rename SharePoint Online files from a CSV and create an audit report.
longDescription: Renames files in a SharePoint Online document library using PnP PowerShell and CSV input. Displays progress and exports a row-by-row audit report with the outcome of each rename.
